text: Petroleum engineering is an engineering discipline that focuses on the exploration, development, production, storage, transportation, and comprehensive utilization of oil and natural gas. Its core lies in efficiently, safely, and environmentally effectively extracting underground oil and gas resources through scientific and technological means, and solving engineering technical problems in the production process. As a core major in the energy field, it directly serves global energy security and economic development, integrating knowledge from multiple disciplines such as geology, mechanics, chemistry, materials science, and management.
